Definition: Jaddua, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jaddua = "knowing"; 1) one of the chiefs of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah; 2) son and successor in the high priesthood of Jonathan, Jeshua, or Johanan; the last of the high priests mentioned in the OT, probably living in the time of Alexander the Great
